definition: Synapse is a component-based development environment for neural networks and adaptive systems.
details: Created by Peltarion, Synapse allows data mining, statistical analysis, visualization, preprocessing, design and training of neural networks and adaptive systems and the deployment of them. It utilizes a plug-in based architecture making it a general platform for signal processing. The first version of the product was released in May 2006.

explainer.lead: A component-based development environment for neural networks and adaptive systems, created by Peltarion. It covers the workflow from data preparation through training to deployment.

tiers.eli5: It is a toolbox where you snap together building blocks to build and train a neural network without writing everything from scratch.
tiers.practitioner: Users apply it for data mining, visualization, preprocessing, network design, training and deployment. Its plug-in architecture makes it a general signal-processing platform, so capability depends on which plug-ins are installed.
tiers.paperLevel: Synapse is a component-based environment allowing data mining, statistical analysis, visualization, preprocessing, design and training of neural networks and adaptive systems, and their deployment; the first version was released in May 2006.

explainer.example: An engineer loads a sensor dataset, preprocesses and visualizes it, designs a neural network from components, trains it, and deploys the trained model.
